出版说明
《水浒》是我国的一部古典文学名著。为了满足广大读者的需要，我们把它编绘成连环画册。在编绘上尽量保持原著故事情节，但是为了适合用连环画来表现，个别情节也作了一些删节和改动。
全部画册分为三十集，每集内容各有比较完整的故事，可以独自成章；同时各集内容上下衔接，以便连续阅读。为了阅读方便，每集开头写有内容提要，结尾附有后记，用以交代上集、本集和下集故事大意。
《水浒》连环画，我社1956年—1962年陆续出版过。现在这套连环画，是用原有的文学脚本重新绘制的。

Water Margin

Publishing Note
"Water Margin" is a classical Chinese literary masterpiece. To meet the needs of a wide readership, we have compiled and illustrated it into a series of picture books. In the illustration, we have tried to preserve the original plot as much as possible, but some scenes have been slightly cut or modified to suit the format of picture books.
This entire series consists of thirty volumes, each containing a relatively complete story that can stand alone; at the same time, the volumes are connected to allow for continuous reading. For convenience, each volume begins with a content summary and ends with a postscript, explaining the plot of the previous, current, and next volumes.
The "Water Margin" picture book series was published by our publishing house between 1956 and 1962. This current set of picture books has been redrawn using the original literary script.

内容提要
上集《三败高俅》说的是：高俅亲自挂帅，抽调
十三万军马进攻梁山。不料三战三败。最后一次全军
覆没，高俅本人也被俘上山。因宋江招安心切，高俅
才保住了性命，受到盛情款待，数日后下山回京。
本集故事紧接上集：宋江日夜盼望朝廷招安，派
燕青和戴宗下山找门路。燕青仍找了李师师这条门路。
果然在李师师家见到了徽宗。燕青当面诉说了梁山替
天行道、盼望招安等情。徽宗派宿太尉去梁山招安。
宋江等接受招安。梁山买市十天后，人马起程进京。
不料徽宗听信奸臣谗言，对宋江等不但未加封赏，反
而意欲加害。幸被宿太尉保奏，宋江、卢俊义领兵出
征抗辽。出师前厢官克扣劳军酒肉，一军校怒杀厢官。
陈桥驿宋江挥泪斩军校后，率大军出发征辽。
1 且说宋江和吴用送走高俅后，和众头领商议招安之事。吴用说：“高俅是个转面忘恩之人。他折了许多军
马，回京必然推病不出，骗过天子。若要等招安，是空
劳神力。”宋江听了，十分着急。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
The previous chapter, "Three Defeats of Gao Qiu," tells of: Gao Qiu personally leading the army, mobilizing
thirteen thousand troops to attack Liangshan. Unexpectedly, they lost all three battles. In the final battle, the entire army
was annihilated, and Gao Qiu himself was captured and taken to the mountain. Because Song Jiang was eager for amnesty, Gao Qiu
was spared and treated with great hospitality, then left the mountain and returned to the capital after several days.
This chapter continues directly from the previous one: Song Jiang longed day and night for imperial amnesty, and sent
Yan Qing and Dai Zong down the mountain to find a way. Yan Qing still chose the path through Li Shishi.
Indeed, at Li Shishi's home, they met Emperor Huizong. Yan Qing personally explained to the emperor Liangshan's mission of
upholding justice and their desire for amnesty. Emperor Huizong sent Su Taixi to Liangshan to offer amnesty.
Song Jiang and others accepted the amnesty. After ten days of buying supplies in Liangshan, the troops set out for the capital.
Unexpectedly, Emperor Huizong, believing the slander of corrupt ministers, not only failed to reward Song Jiang and others, but
intended to harm them. Fortunately, Su Taixi pleaded on their behalf, and Song Jiang and Lu Junyi led the troops to fight against Liao.
Before departure, the military officer embezzled the soldiers' wine and meat, and one soldier angrily killed the officer.
At Chenqiao Post Station, after Song Jiang wept and executed the soldier, he led the army to set out for the campaign against Liao.
1. After Song Jiang and Wu Yong sent Gao Qiu away, they discussed the matter of amnesty with the other leaders. Wu Yong said: "Gao Qiu is a man who forgets kindness as soon as his back is turned. He has lost many troops and horses; upon returning to the capital, he will surely pretend to be ill and avoid the emperor, deceiving the Son of Heaven. If we wait for amnesty, it will be a waste of effort." Song Jiang, upon hearing this, became very anxious.
summary_zh: 本页为《水浒》连环画第廿七集《受招安遭陷害》的内容提要和第一幅画面。提要回顾了上集高俅三败被俘的情节，并概述了本集宋江盼招安、燕青找李师师、徽宗派宿太尉招安、梁山受招安后进京、遭奸臣陷害、最终出征抗辽的主线。第一幅图描绘了宋江与吴用等头领在忠义堂商议招安之事，吴用劝宋江勿等高俅，以免空耗心力。

2 吴用主张再派两个精细人，多带财礼，去京师探听消息；同时另找门路，把梁山衷情通达圣上，使高俅隐瞒不住，这是上策。燕青说李师师这条门路，似还可以再去试试。宋江应允，派戴宗和燕青同去。
3 神机军师朱武道：“兄长昔日打华州时，和宿太尉打过交道。此人是个忠厚仁慈的人，若得他在天子面前保奏招安之事，大有好处。”宋江听了，想起闻焕章和宿太尉交往密切，便请闻焕章给宿太尉写信诉说此事。
page_text_en:
2 Wu Yong proposed sending two careful men, with plenty of gifts, to the capital to gather information; at the same time, find another way to convey the true feelings of Liangshan to the Emperor, so that Gao Qiu could not hide it any longer—this was the best strategy. Yan Qing said the path through Li Shishi might still be worth trying. Song Jiang agreed and sent Dai Zong and Yan Qing together.
3 The ingenious military strategist Zhu Wu said, "Brother, when we attacked Huazhou before, you had dealings with Minister Su. He is a loyal and kind-hearted man. If he could present the matter of amnesty to the Emperor, it would be very beneficial." Song Jiang, upon hearing this, recalled that Wen Huanzhang had close relations with Minister Su, and thus asked Wen Huanzhang to write a letter to Minister Su explaining the situation.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了梁山泊为促成招安而商议对策的场景：吴用建议派戴宗和燕青去京城探听消息并联络李师师；朱武则提议通过与宿太尉有旧交的闻焕章写信求助，以争取朝廷招安。

4 闻焕章立刻动手写好一信。宋江把信交给燕青，让他随身带好；又叫人收拾金珠细软两大笼子，打发燕青戴宗二人下山行事。
5 燕青、戴宗二人扮作公人模样，不一日，来到东京。把门军汉拦住，不准他们进城。燕青笑问：‘这是怎的？’军汉道：‘殿帅府有钧旨：为防梁山贼人混入，过往人等一律盘查。’
page_text_en:
4 Wen Huanzhang immediately wrote a letter. Song Jiang gave the letter to Yan Qing, telling him to keep it with him; he also ordered someone to prepare two large cages filled with gold, jewels, and fine goods, and sent Yan Qing and Dai Zong off to carry out their mission.
5 Yan Qing and Dai Zong, disguised as officials, arrived in Dongjing in no time. The guards at the gate stopped them and refused to let them enter. Yan Qing laughed and asked, 'What's going on?' The soldier replied, 'By order of the Palace Commander's Office: to prevent bandits from Liangshan from sneaking in, all passersby are subject to inspection.'
summary_zh: 本页描绘了梁山泊为促成招安的后续行动：闻焕章写信后，宋江将信交给燕青并准备财物，派燕青和戴宗下山；二人扮作公人抵达东京，却被守门军汉以防范梁山贼人混入为由拦下盘查。

6 燕青取出假公文，劈脸丢将过去：“你看这是开封府公文不是？俺两个从小在开封府当差，这门下不知出入了几万遭，你反倒只管盘问。梁山泊的人，却眼睁睁都放过去了。
7 那监门官听得，便对军汉喝道：“有开封府公文，只管问他怎的！放他入去。”燕青一把抓了公文，揣在怀里，和戴宗挑起行李便走。军汉忙退向一边，放他们进城。
page_text_en:
6 Yan Qing pulled out a fake official document and threw it in their faces: "Look, isn't this an official document from Kaifeng Prefecture? We've been working here since we were young. We've passed through this gate tens of thousands of times. You're the ones who keep questioning us, while people from Liangshan Marsh are let through without a second glance.
7 The gatekeeper, upon hearing this, shouted at the soldiers: "There's an official document from Kaifeng Prefecture! What are you questioning him for? Let him in!" Yan Qing grabbed the document, tucked it into his chest, and walked away with Dai Zong, who was carrying their luggage. The soldiers quickly stepped aside and let them enter the city.
summary_zh: 燕青和戴宗扮作公人抵达东京城门，被守门军汉盘查。燕青出示假公文并斥责对方偏袒梁山贼人，监门官听后命令放行，二人顺利进城。

8 两人进城，寻个客店住下。次日，燕青换了洁净衣衫，扮作游手好闲的纨绔子弟，随身带着金银珠宝，对戴宗道：‘哥哥，小弟今日去李师师家打探消息，如果事情败露，哥哥快自回去。’
9 燕青径投李师师家来，到了门前看时，依旧曲栏雕柱，绿窗朱户，比先时修得更好。这李师师家原是东京有名的妓院，因皇上时常来，闲杂人等，都不敢入内。
page_text_en:
8 The two entered the city and found an inn to stay at. The next day, Yan Qing changed into clean clothes, dressed as a idle young man of wealth, carried gold and jewels, and said to Dai Zong: 'Brother, I will go to Li Shishi's house today to gather information. If things go wrong, you must leave quickly.'
9 Yan Qing headed straight for Li Shishi's residence. When he arrived at the gate, he saw the same curved railings and carved pillars, green windows and red doors, even more beautifully maintained than before. Li Shishi's house was a famous brothel in Dongjing, and because the emperor often visited, no commoners dared to enter.
summary_zh: 燕青与戴宗进城后住店，次日燕青装扮成富家子弟，携带金银珠宝，准备去李师师家打探消息，并嘱咐戴宗若事败则速离。随后，燕青前往李师师家，看到其宅院依旧华丽，因皇帝常来，闲杂人等不敢入内。

10 燕青进得门来，李妈妈见了大吃一惊，说道：“你如何又来此间？”燕青道：“请出娘子来，我自有话说。”李妈妈道：“你们前番元宵节闯了大祸，如今还有什么话好说？”燕青道：“只等娘子出来，方才说的。
11 李师师在窗后听了多时，见他如此说，便走了出来。燕青忙拜了两拜，说道：“前者惊吓了娘子，特来请罪。”李师师道：“你们当初说是行商客人，却闹出那般大祸，如今须将实情对我说知。”
page_text_en:
10 Yan Qing entered the gate. Li Mama was greatly surprised and said, “How have you come here again?” Yan Qing replied, “Please bring out the lady; I have something to say.” Li Mama said, “You caused a great disaster during the Lantern Festival last time. What more can you say now?” Yan Qing replied, “I’ll speak only when the lady comes out.
11 Li Shishi had been listening from behind the window for a long time. Seeing him speak this way, she came out. Yan Qing hurriedly bowed twice and said, “I came to apologize for frightening you before.” Li Shishi said, “You claimed to be traveling merchants at first, yet caused such a great disaster. Now you must tell me the truth.”
summary_zh: 燕青来到李师师府邸，被李妈妈拦住询问，称其上次元宵节闯祸，燕青请求见李师师。李师师听后现身，燕青行礼请罪，李师师要求其说明真实情况。

12 燕青道：“小人乃是梁山浪子燕青。前次上元夜大闹东京，都是梁山好汉。当初我哥哥宋江求见娘子，非为买笑图欢，实指望娘子将梁山‘替天行道’，‘保国安民’的心愿，转奏圣上，早得招安。”
13 李师师等人闻听大惊。燕青又说：“请娘子勿惊，我等实无歹意。只是如今奸臣当道，谗佞专权，闭塞言路，下情不能上达。因此上才寻这条门路。不想惊吓了娘子，罪该万死。”
page_text_en:
12 Yan Qing said, "I am Yan Qing, the浪子 of Liangshan. The previous Lantern Festival night's disturbance in Dongjing was caused by Liangshan heroes. My brother Song Jiang sought to meet you, not for pleasure, but truly hoping you would convey Liangshan's wish to 'uphold heaven's mandate' and 'protect the nation and its people' to the Emperor, so we could be granted amnesty early."
13 Li Shishi and others were greatly startled. Yan Qing continued, "Please do not be alarmed, Madam. We truly have no ill intent. It is only that now, with villains in power and sycophants monopolizing authority, the channels of communication are blocked, and the concerns of the people cannot reach the Emperor. That is why we have sought this path. I am sorry to have frightened you, Madam; I deserve to die a thousand deaths."
summary_zh: 燕青在李师师府邸向其说明梁山泊求见的真正目的，即请求她将梁山‘替天行道’、‘保国安民’的心愿转奏皇帝，以求招安，并解释此次前来并非恶意，而是因奸臣当道、言路闭塞，才不得已走此门路。

14 燕青又打开帕子，将珠宝摊在桌上，笑道：“今俺宋江哥哥无可拜送，带来些微礼，还请笑纳。”李妈妈爱的是财，一见便喜，忙命丫环安排细食茶果，殷勤相待。
15 李师师亲自陪酒。燕青道：“小人如何敢和娘子对坐。”李师师道：“快别这样说。你们梁山义士，久已闻名，只是中间无人作成，下情不能上达，才使你们受了许多委屈。”
page_text_en:
14 Yan Qing opened his silk pouch again, laid out the jewels on the table, and smiled, saying, “My brother Song Jiang has nothing to offer, so I’ve brought these small gifts—please accept them.” Li Mama, who loved wealth, was delighted at the sight and immediately ordered her maids to prepare fine food, tea, and fruits, treating him with great hospitality.
15 Li Shishi personally accompanied him with wine. Yan Qing said, “How dare I sit opposite you, Madam?” Li Shishi replied, “Don’t say that. Your fellow heroes from Liangshan have long been renowned. It’s just that there’s no one in the middle to help you, so your pleas cannot reach the Emperor, and thus you’ve suffered many hardships.”
summary_zh: 燕青在李师师府邸献上珠宝作为礼物，李妈妈欢喜地安排款待；随后李师师亲自陪酒，对燕青表示理解，称梁山好汉久负盛名，只是因无人引荐，下情难以上达，才受了许多委屈。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘
title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed
source_file: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘（8-12岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:

17 李师师道：“他这样破耗钱粮，损兵折将，如何敢奏？这话我尽知了，以后当设法面奏圣上。如今且放宽心，请饮几杯酒吧！”燕青推辞不过，只得陪饮了几杯。
page_text_en:

Therefore, my brother released him, and sent Xiao Rang and Le He to accompany him. But we have heard nothing since they left.'

summary_zh: 燕青向李师师详细讲述了梁山泊两次击败童贯、三次击败高俅的战绩，并说明高俅被擒后曾发誓回朝保奏招安，但派去的萧让、乐和却杳无音信。李师师听后表示理解，承诺会设法向皇帝奏报，并劝燕青放宽心，陪他饮了几杯酒。

title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

page_text_en:

summary_zh: 燕青在李师师府中，李师师为他吹笛唱曲，后燕青为避纠缠，谎称愿拜李师师为姐姐，李师师欣然接受并扶起他。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘
title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed
source_file: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘（8-12岁）.pdf

summary_zh: 燕青在李师师府中认李妈妈为干娘，并在李师师邀请下答应留宿，以便有机会向皇帝陈情梁山招安之意。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘

page_text_en:

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘
title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

page_text_en:

summary_zh: 李师师向徽宗介绍燕青的来历，燕青为徽宗吹箫唱曲，先唱《渔家傲》令徽宗大喜，后又唱一曲哀怨之歌，引起徽宗惊问。

summary_zh: 燕青向徽宗陈情，称自己被梁山劫去后逃回，不敢露面；徽宗赦免其罪。李师师随即请求徽宗为燕青亲笔写下赦书，徽宗应允并写下‘特赦燕青无罪，诸司不许拿问’，并署名‘道君皇帝’。

title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

summary_zh: 燕青向徽宗详细陈述了梁山两次招安未成的原因及两破童贯、三败高俅的经过，并说明释放高俅及留下闻焕章作质的情况；徽宗听后感叹，意识到此前童贯和高俅所奏的军情均为谎报。

title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

summary_zh: 燕青和戴宗向宿太尉呈上梁山的礼物并说明来意，宿太尉收下珍宝，答应尽力向皇帝奏请招安，二人拜谢后告辞离开。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘
title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

The two of them disguised themselves as officials, spying outside Gao Qiu's mansion, waiting for someone from the mansion to come out so they could find a way to send a message.
41 Shortly after, a young servant came out, swaggering. Yan Qing stepped forward and bowed to him. The servant asked, "Who are you?" Yan Qing replied, "Please, young master, let's have a talk at the nearby teahouse."
summary_zh: 萧让和乐和仍被关在高俅府中，燕青与同伴扮作公人，在府外窥探，等待机会传递消息。不久，一名小家人走出府门，燕青上前施礼，邀请他到附近茶楼密谈。

title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

43 戴宗便向袖内取出一锭大银，放在桌子上，说：“你只要引乐和出来相见一面，不要出衙门，便送这锭银子给你。”那人见了财物，才说：“我与你唤出来，说了话，你休失信。”
page_text_en:
42 The three sat together drinking tea. Dai Zong said, "To be honest with you, sir. The two men brought from Liangshan Marsh by the Grand Marshal earlier, one of them is named Le He, who is a relative of my brother. I wish to see him for a moment. Please grant me this favor." The servant merely shook his head and refused.
43 Dai Zong then took a large ingot of silver from his sleeve, placed it on the table, and said, "If you can bring Le He out to meet me for just a moment, without leaving the official residence, I will give you this silver ingot." Seeing the money, the man replied, "I'll call him out for you. After we speak, you must not break your promise."
summary_zh: 戴宗与燕青在茶楼与高俅府中的小家人见面，请求引见被囚禁的乐和，起初被拒，后戴宗以一锭银子为酬，小家人答应帮忙引见。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘

page_text_en:
44 The servant went in for less than half an hour, then hurriedly came out and said, 'Bring the silver first. Le He has been called out to a side room. It's inconvenient with too many people; only one person may enter.' Dai Zong then handed the silver to him. The servant immediately led Yan Qing into the mansion.

summary_zh: 小家人带燕青进入高俅府中，燕青与被囚禁的乐和见面，得知其被囚于后花园，并商定当晚四更前来营救。

page_text_en:

47 As it was already the fourth watch, the two got ashore, stood outside the wall and coughed. Inside the wall, a reply cough came. Both sides understood the signal. Yan Qing then threw the rope over the wall.
summary_zh: 燕青与戴宗为营救被囚禁的乐和，先在高俅府后的小河空船中藏身，待到四更时分，两人上岸在墙外咳嗽作为暗号，与墙内接应的人取得联系，燕青随即把绳索抛过墙去，准备实施营救。

49 次日一早，四个人到旅店取了行李，仍假扮公人模样，混出城门，直奔梁山泊而去。
page_text_en:
48 After a while, Yue He and Xiao Rang both climbed the rope, crossed the wall, and then slid down the rope. Since it was still dark, the four of them remained hidden in the boat.
49 The next morning, the four of them went to the inn to collect their luggage, still disguised as officials, slipped out of the city gate, and headed straight for Liangshan Marsh.
summary_zh: 乐和与萧让成功攀绳越墙脱困，与燕青、戴宗在船中隐蔽；次日清晨，四人取行李假扮公人，混出城门，直奔梁山泊。

51 却说这天徽宗早朝，问童贯招讨梁山之事。童贯仍然虚奏谎报。徽宗大怒，喝道：“你们这些奸佞之臣，几乎坏了国家大事。你和高俅两次出征，全军惨败，寡人早已知晓，还敢胡说！”
page_text_en:
50 And so, the attendants of Gao Qiu's mansion came the next day to bring food to Xiao Rang and Le He, but could not find them anywhere. Seeing the rope tied to the chair, they concluded they had escaped without a doubt, and hurriedly reported to Gao Qiu. Gao Qiu was greatly shocked, and added much worry to his heart, staying in the mansion every day, pretending to be ill and not going out.
51 On this day, Emperor Huizong held an early court session and asked Tong Guan about the campaign against Liangshan. Tong Guan still gave false reports. The emperor became furious and shouted, "You treacherous ministers, you have nearly ruined the nation's affairs. You and Gao Qiu have led two campaigns, both ending in total defeat, and I have already known this. How dare you lie!"
summary_zh: 高俅府中仆人发现萧让、乐和逃跑，高俅惊慌称病不出；与此同时，徽宗早朝质问童贯，因童贯谎报军情而大怒斥责。

53 徽宗亲笔草了招安的丹诏，命宿太尉为使臣，携带金牌、银牌、红锦、绿绸、御酒等礼物，前往梁山招抚宋江。
page_text_en:
52 Tong Guan trembled and stepped aside. Minister Su also presented to the emperor the matter of Gao Qiu secretly detaining the Liangshan heroes, feigning illness to avoid court, and repeatedly obstructing the pacification of Liangshan. The Emperor said, “Right now, pacifying Song Jiang and others is urgent. The traitorous ministers who have harmed the state will be dealt with later.”
53 The Emperor personally wrote the edict for pacification, appointing Minister Su as the envoy, carrying golden and silver plaques, red brocade, green silk, imperial wine, and other gifts, to go to Liangshan to pacify Song Jiang.
summary_zh: 徽宗在朝堂上听宿太尉揭发高俅阻挠招安，遂决定先招抚宋江，后惩治奸臣，并亲笔写下招安诏书，命宿太尉携带礼物前往梁山。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传27：受招安遭陷害》冀平 王茜 绘
title_en: Water Margin 27: Accepted into the Imperial Army, Betrayed

page_text_en:

55 Meanwhile, Minister Su and his entourage arrived in Jizhou, where Governor Zhang Shuye welcomed them into the city and hosted a banquet. During the feast, Minister Su mentioned the gifts he brought, wondering if Liangshan would find them too light. Zhang Shuye replied, "This group of men care not for the weight of the gifts, but only for loyalty and serving the country." Immediately, he sent someone to Liangshan to inform Song Jiang to prepare for their arrival.
summary_zh: 燕青、戴宗、萧让、乐和四人返回梁山，向宋江汇报营救成功；同时，宿太尉等人抵达济州，太守张叔夜设宴款待，并派人通知梁山准备迎接招安使团。

57 众人直到忠义堂前下马。宿太尉读了皇帝亲笔丹诏，又取过金牌银牌，红绿锦缎，递与宋江。宋江等山呼万岁，拜谢圣恩。
page_text_en:

At the three passes, drums and music resounded, and along the way, dozens of colorful pavilions had already been erected; the ceremony to receive the imperial edict was very grand.
57 The group dismounted before the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness. Minister Su read the emperor's personally written edict, then took out the gold and silver plaques and red and green brocade, handing them to Song Jiang. Song Jiang and the others shouted 'Long live the emperor!' and bowed to express their gratitude for the imperial grace.
summary_zh: 宿太尉与张叔夜前往梁山，宋江率众头领隆重迎接；众人至忠义堂前，宿太尉宣读皇帝诏书并递交赏赐，宋江等山呼万岁，拜谢圣恩。

page_text_en:

Minister Su ordered someone to open the imperial wine, poured a cup full, and said to the leaders: "I fear you might doubt, so I, Minister Su Yuansheng, will drink this cup first, for all of you to see." He then raised the cup and drank it in one gulp.
59 After Minister Su finished drinking, he poured more wine and first offered it to Song Jiang, who thanked him and drank. Then Lu Junyi, Wu Yong, and Gongsun Sheng drank in turn. Minister Su then offered wine to all one hundred and eight leaders, and each drank a full cup.
summary_zh: 梁山为迎接朝廷招安使臣宿太尉，大摆筵席。宿太尉为表诚意，先饮御酒以示无毒，随后依次劝宋江、卢俊义、吴用、公孙胜及众头领饮酒，众人皆饮尽以示信任。

If I do not return soon to report, I fear the treacherous ministers will envy me and cause trouble." Song Jiang, seeing his reasoning was sound, agreed. He led all the leaders, accompanied by music and drums, to see him off for thirty miles.
61 Song Jiang and others returned to the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness, beat the drums to gather the troops, and immediately issued an order: "Today we have received the imperial amnesty. We, the one hundred and eight of us, will all go to the imperial court to serve the nation. As for the other soldiers, those who wish to go may sign up. Those who do not wish to go will be given money and property to make their own living."
summary_zh: 宿太尉辞别梁山返回京城，宋江率众送行至三十里外；随后宋江在忠义堂召集众将，宣布接受招安，决定一百零八人赴朝廷效力，其余军校可自愿选择去留。

63 梁山库存的财物，除分散各头领和军校外，尚有不少。宋江想起自聚义以来，多得四方百姓的协助，为表示感谢，决定将大小财物，低价变卖。于是，便差人到四方乡里，广张买市的告示。
page_text_en:

Song Jiang, recalling that since their gathering in righteousness, they had received much help from the people of all regions, decided to sell off all the treasures at low prices as a token of gratitude. Thus, he sent people to the surrounding villages to widely post notices for the sale.
summary_zh: 宋江下令让梁山军士自行商议去留，约有三五千人选择离开，其余人愿随宋江归顺朝廷；同时，宋江为感谢百姓支持，决定低价变卖梁山剩余财物，并派人张贴卖物告示。

summary_zh: 梁山在招安后举办买市，四方居民上山选购物品，梁山半卖半送，还宰牛羊备酒食招待乡民，百姓感激不尽。

69 天使来到宋江营中，宣读圣旨：“原是京师降将，仍还本处。外路军兵，各归原所。其余各军，分作五路，往山东、河北，分调各处。”

Emperor Huizong immediately approved the petition.

summary_zh: 梁山好汉得知朝廷要将他们分散调开后，纷纷表示不愿分离，宁愿回梁山；宋江恳求天使向朝廷转达请求收回成命。天使回朝后，徽宗大惊，急召童贯商议对策。

summary_zh: 徽宗采纳宿太尉建议，任命宋江为破辽都先锋、卢俊义为副先锋，命其出征辽国；宿太尉至宋江营中宣读圣旨，宋江率众表示愿为国出力、尽忠报国，并得知次日将在陈桥驿犒赏三军。
